```{r}
library(tidyverse)

metadata <- read_csv("data/metadata.csv")
expression <- read_csv("data/expression.csv")
```

```{r}
# join datasets and stanarize colum names
data_merged <- expression %>%
  rename(sample_id = SampleID) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")

# View the merged data preview
head(data_merged)
  
```

```{r}
# Join datasets and fix group name typos
data_merged <- expression %>%
  rename(sample_id = SampleID) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    group = str_to_title(group),
    group = if_else(group == "Treatmnt", "Treatment", group)
  )

head(data_merged)
```


```{r}
# 1. Plot gene expression levels across groups
ggplot(data_merged, aes(x = group, y = Expression, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Gene Expression Comparison Across Groups",
    x = "Group",
    y = "Expression Level"
  )
```

```{r}
# Statistical analysis: Mean difference, Log2 Fold Change, and Welch's t-test 
diff_expr <- data_merged %>%
  filter(!is.na(Expression), !is.na(group)) %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise( 
    mean_control = round(mean(Expression[group == "Control"]), 2),
    mean_treatment = round(mean(Expression[group == "Treatment"]), 2),
    log2_fc = round(log2(mean_treatment / mean_control), 2),
    p_value = round(t.test(Expression ~ group)$p.value, 4),
    .groups = "drop"
) %>%
mutate(
  significant = if_else(p_value < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
)
diff_expr
```
